manual_basis: Installed manual physical p428 documents DamageReplacement first for a damaged item, then DamageRepair, then ordinary SystemRepair/ItemReplacement when damage-specific rows are absent. Installed dictionary fixes the ItemReplacement and DamageReplacement keys. The accepted primary-LRU parent has a half-hour damage-specific E01-SURP task and one local spare.
source_delta: The accepted primary-LRU source gains a BASE-01 ordinary ItemReplacement row with SURPT1 hour in both arms. The explicit arm retains the accepted DamageReplacement SURPT0.5/TID E01-SURP row; the fallback arm differs only by clearing that row and changing ProblemDescription. Both retain one mounted LRU, one spare, BATTLE-HIT DAMP1/PROB1/REPF1, three fixed missions, seed1 and horizon36.

pre_run_hypotheses.explicit: The damaged LRU should use the half-hour DamageReplacement E01-SURP route despite the ordinary one-hour ItemReplacement alternative.
pre_run_hypotheses.fallback: With DamageReplacement absent, the same item-identified BATTLE-HIT damage should use ordinary ItemReplacement, with a distinct one-hour system replacement duration, later readiness and matching report exposure; removed items should still be repaired by inherited ItemRepair.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, no replacement, an equal or ambiguous duration, different damage/stock path, or other behavior is diagnostic only. Process exit alone cannot establish fallback or priority.

acceptance_gates: Accepted direct parent and independent pre-run static review of frozen sources, exact diff, manual/dictionary basis and guarded runner
Two fresh serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
Exact authored row-containing table roundtrips and zero converter errors with valid SXO/event log/report
Physical damaged LRU, stock issue, system replacement task source and duration, item repair, mission outcome, 72 System/Stock bins and terminal readiness reconcile in both arms
SHA-256 sealed raw evidence and independent read-only post-run replay
limits: One fixed seed tests DamageReplacement-to-ItemReplacement fallback for a directly mounted primary LRU at one station. It does not establish DamageRepair-to-SystemRepair here, multi-item damage, forwarding, shortages, other tasks, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
